title: Add The Mita (Roblox AI) to chat
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [The Mita (Roblox AI)](https://www.roblox.com/games/98105867888961/The-Mita) to chat
- This AI powers a game character named Mita from MiSide. It runs on a Flask server and connects to the Roblox game via HTTP. The AI receives the player’s spoken lines, along with conversation history a

Fixes #13559

gist.headline: Mita joins the conversation
gist.blurb: A new resident moved into the hive: The Mita, a Roblox character AI that listens, remembers the thread, and talks back. Polli brought flowers; Mita brought a Flask server.
gist.summary: Added The Mita, a Roblox AI powering the Mita character from MiSide, to the chat app registry, with a Flask-and-HTTP setup that receives player speech and conversation history.
gist.impact: People can now discover The Mita through Pollinations chat, connecting spoken Roblox roleplay with a character that keeps the conversation context.
gist.visual_concept: Depict The Mita as a friendly pixel-game character appearing through a cozy retro terminal connected by a dotted HTTP line to a small Roblox-like game window. Polli, wearing a tiny gaming headset, offers her a flower-shaped microphone beside code-plants, representing spoken dialogue and remembered conversation.
